fully_insured.label: Fully Insured (State-Regulated)
fully_insured.description: Plans purchased directly from insurer, regulated by NY Department of Financial Services.

internal_appeal.notes: Must exhaust internal appeal (2 levels) before external review.

external_appeal.deadline_note: 120 days from final internal denial (or 120 days from initial denial if urgent/concurrent review).
key_citations: NY Insurance Law §4914 — External Appeal Rights
11 NYCRR 410 — Utilization Review and External Appeal regulations
NY Public Health Law §4900-4910 — External appeal for HMO and insured plans
required_documents: Copy of final adverse determination (denial letter)

self_funded_erisa.label: Self-Funded / ERISA Plan
self_funded_erisa.description: Employer self-funded plans governed by federal ERISA law, not state insurance regulations.

internal_appeal.notes: Must exhaust internal appeal (2 levels) before federal external review. ERISA requires plan to respond within 30 days (pre-service) or 60 days (post-service).

external_appeal.deadline_note: 120 days from receipt of final internal adverse benefit determination.
key_citations: 29 CFR §2590.715-2719 — Internal Claims and Appeals and External Review Processes
ACA §2719 — External review requirements for non-grandfathered plans
DOL Technical Release 2010-01 — External review process standards
required_documents: Copy of final adverse benefit determination
Plan's Summary Plan Description (SPD) showing external review rights
Authorization forms as required by the IRO
notes: ERISA plans must use an accredited IRO for external review
Decision is binding on the plan
State external appeal (NY DFS) does NOT apply to self-funded ERISA plans
If plan fails to comply with claims procedure, claimant is deemed to have exhausted internal appeals

routing_logic.description: Determine escalation path based on Plan Type field in Monday.com board.

rules.alert_message: ESCALATION: Fully Insured plan — file NY DFS External Appeal within {days_remaining} days.
ESCALATION: ERISA plan — file Federal External Review (IRO) within {days_remaining} days.

deadline_alerts.message_template: DEADLINE ALERT: {patient_name} — {denial_code} appeal filing deadline in {days_remaining} days ({deadline_date}). Current status: {appeal_status}.
